title: Tachyon terminal declaration (.tachyon/terminals/<name>.yml)
description: One terminal (server, shell, build) — the file's mapping is the declaration; the name is the filename.

cmd.description: Shell command that runs the terminal.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the terminal session. For Pi runtime commands, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR are Tachyon-owned private-home boundaries and must not be set here.

autostart.description: Start this terminal when Tachyon starts.

watch.description: Glob(s) — restart the terminal when a matching file changes.

attention.description: Needs-you detection. Defaults off for terminals. Object form tunes the idle threshold and adds prompt patterns.

silenceSec.description: Seconds of unchanged pane + idle CPU before the agent is marked idle.

patterns.description: Extra prompt regexes (case-insensitive) that mark the agent as needing input.

restart.description: Crash policy: on-crash auto-restarts when the process dies with a non-zero exit (backoff 2s/4s/8s, max 3 per minute). Clean exits (0) never auto-restart.
